patterns.name: Two Pointers
patterns.description: Use two pointers to iterate through an array or string, often moving towards each other or in the same direction.
whenToUse: Finding pairs that meet a condition
examples: Two Sum II - Input Array is Sorted

patterns.name: Sliding Window
patterns.description: Maintain a window of elements that slides through the array, useful for subarray/substring problems.
examples: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K

patterns.name: Fast & Slow Pointers
patterns.description: Use two pointers moving at different speeds, often used to detect cycles.

patterns.name: Breadth-First Search
patterns.description: Explore all neighbors at current depth before moving to next level. Uses a queue.

patterns.name: Depth-First Search
patterns.description: Explore as far as possible along each branch before backtracking. Uses stack or recursion.

patterns.name: Binary Search
patterns.description: Efficiently search sorted arrays by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.
examples: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
